sentences.text: Petitioner was the accused in C.C.No.1090 of 2009 on the file of the Judicial First Class Magistrate Court, Chavakkad.

entities.text: Judicial First Class Magistrate Court, Chavakkad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: He and the co-accused allegedly committed certain offences under the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act 1954.
He was not available; only the others were proceeded against.
By Annexure-A2 order the learned Magistrate discharged the co-accused.
The case against the petitioner has been refiled as C.C.No.441 of 2015.
The proceedings are sought to be quashed in the light of the discharge of the co-accused.

3. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Public Prosecutor.
4.
I am satisfied that the case of the petitioner and of the co-accused who have been discharged by the trial court stands on the same footing.
The petitioner also is entitled to discharge.
In the result, this Crl.M.C is allowed.
The proceedings in C.C.No.441 of 2015 on the file of the Judicial First Class Magistrate Court, Chavakkad are quashed.
